name: Piperacillin + Tazobactam
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.indication: Most indications (adults; e.g., intra-abdominal, skin, community-acquired pneumonia)

usual_adult_dose.dose: 4.5 g IV every 6 hours plus an aminoglycoside (18 g/day)

key_interactions.effect: More acute kidney injury with the combination.
Piperacillin inactivates aminoglycosides; tobramycin levels can fall markedly in hemodialysis patients.
key_interactions.action: Monitor aminoglycoside levels in ESKD; give separately (Y-site compatible only with amikacin and gentamicin in certain diluents, not tobramycin).
Do not combine unless benefit outweighs risk.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Vecuronium and other non-depolarizing neuromuscular blockers

serious: CNS reactions (seizures with high doses or kidney impairment)
Sodium load (2.84 mEq per g of piperacillin) and hypokalemia

contraindications: History of allergic reactions to any penicillin, cephalosporin or beta-lactamase inhibitor
monitoring: Kidney function (dose by CrCl; nephrotoxicity in critical illness; with vancomycin)
Blood counts and coagulation in prolonged therapy or with anticoagulants

pk.peak: At the end of the IV infusion
pk.half_life_eskd: At CrCl <20 mL/min: about 2-fold longer (piperacillin) and 4-fold longer (tazobactam) (label)
pk.vd: Piperacillin about 15 to 17 L; tazobactam about 15 to 17 L
pk.metabolism: Piperacillin: minor active desethyl metabolite. Tazobactam: one inactive metabolite
pk.excretion_renal_pct: Piperacillin 68% unchanged in urine; tazobactam 80% unchanged
pk.dialyzability: Yes: hemodialysis removes 30% to 40% of a dose; PD removes about 6% (piperacillin) and 21% (tazobactam) (label).

sources.citation: Baxter Healthcare Corporation. (2026). Zosyn (piperacillin sodium and tazobactam sodium) [Prescribing information; US FDA-approved label, NDA050750, set ID 8db6bd91-2106-4bfd-8cc8-38aaf1e18d17, version effective May 15, 2026]. DailyMed, U.S. National Library of Medicine.

draft_notes: Vd values read from the label PK table (V in L: 14.7 to 17.4); rounded to 15 to 17 L.
